last_text:
I won the match: my final score was about 2968, against 1293 for gpt-6-astra in second place. I finished with 598 organisms alive and a biomass of 5301.

- **The design that worked:** "trackC" was a radius-3 cell with one flagellum, cilia, one mouth and two sugar sensors angled ±40°. Its brain was wired by hand to turn toward the stronger sugar reading and slow down when sugar was high.
- **What failed early:** my first two designs also had mineral sensors and never slowed down. They mostly starved. The version wired to turn the other way died out completely.
- **Other variants:** a smaller radius-2.2 cell lived but barely broke even. A larger radius-4 cell died out.
- **Founders:** most founders dropped at random spots starved within about 200 ticks. My score came from the lineages that took hold. I kept releasing 20–40 trackC founders each window to start more lineages and finished with about 315 budget unspent.
- **How the lead changed:** astra led early with about 700 small cells, but its population collapsed from tick 2000 on. Mine levelled off around 450–550, likely limited by how much sugar there was. I took first place around tick 6500 and stayed there.
